svg.text: Soldering view — case upside down, top edge (number/letter row) away from you
Each COLOUR = one diode: starts at its switch's pin 2, crosses its own switch, band in the gap below,
then its leg runs along the gap and CROSSES the next key's leg = solder joint (grey dot). Colour changes = next diode.
Blue = wire where legs can't reach. Yellow = column wire on pin 1. DOTTED = cable from that end to its controller hole.
Controller drawn ABOVE the keys at its real left/right spot (it actually sits under the top keys), seen from its back, USB to the back edge. Shown 1.4x size.
LEFT HALF — case upside down (what you see while soldering)
RIGHT HALF — case upside down (what you see while soldering)
